plan.deduplication: Canonical lowercase whitespace, unordered pair key; exclude exact matches to the corresponding GLUE full train+validation before label-blind sampling
plan.selection: All coefficients and methods frozen from previous source calibration; no target adaptation or label-dependent model selection
metrics: mean of two accuracies, descriptive only
plan.scope: First use of these target subsets in this project. Small two-domain transfer check, not a new independent model development program, not pretraining-contamination-free, and not full GLUE/OOD robustness. IMDb long review truncation is a confound.
